evidence: Both reports give 39 participants (29 male, 10 female), two 21,000-ft exposures per participant, the same exercise dose, 3-hour dwell and treatment test. The 1991 wording gives nine cases (four control and five exercise). The 1992 paper explicitly gives 15 symptomatic exposures and identifies nine discordant participant pairs with the same split. The exact reconciliation supports using the 1992 exposure totals and retaining the conference values as reported wording from the same trial.
